body:
Cannot complete #1887 until its required waterjet prerequisites are available.
Current upstream/main is cda3d58965843c30c6c70d59c06ac27c4dcda8b0.
At that commit, crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs has no WaterjetProfile, crates/tools/src/tools.rs has no ToolKind::Waterjet, and assets/posts has no waterjet post.
#1882, #1883, and #1885 remain open. No open PR matched those issue numbers or WaterjetProfile.
PR #2001 implements #1881 machine and tool kinds, but explicitly excludes a concrete waterjet operation and built-in waterjet posts. Stacking on it cannot supply the required workflow.
Implementing those prerequisites would exceed this worker's scope of #1887 only.
No claim was made. No repository files were changed. No tests or gates were run.
Resume #1887 when the operation, verification, and post prerequisites are available.
